entity: US rural vs urban jail incarceration rates (rural 2.5x urban in 2023)
what_we_add: the 2023 rates on a fixed-county, ages 15-64 basis: 563 vs 227 per 100K, and Butts GA / Yazoo MS growing ~4x on local holds
why: Vera and the NYT-derived coverage state the same finding same direction: rural jail rates more than double urban, urban falling, and Vera 2024 confirms rural back at 2019 levels. Nobody has the 2023 563-vs-227 numbers or the two named counties.
